title: amphithalea dahlgrenii
intro: Amphithalea dahlgrenii, commonly known as the Sneeze Weed, is a plant species in the family Fabaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Amphithalea dahlgrenii include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion and promote coughing, as well as its antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
